lines.en: label harukaspring2:
scene sky
Every once in a while, I’ll wake up before I’m supposed to.
lines.zh: 每隔一阵子，我就会在预定时间之前醒来。

lines.en: Which isn’t to say I’m governed by a strict morning curfew that Ami has laid out or anything of the sort. Just that I like to pretend the world isn’t real until at least 8:00 AM.
lines.zh: 这并不是说我被 Ami 定下的什么严格晨间作息之类的东西管着。只是我喜欢假装这个世界至少在早上八点之前都还不真实。

lines.en: So, as far as I’m concerned, the fact that it’s barely past 7:00 makes me feel as if I’m wandering through an unsettling liminal space tucked somewhere between Kumon-mi and whatever Yasu’s death plane is.
lines.zh: 所以对我来说，现在刚过七点这件事，让我感觉自己正行走在一片令人不安的阈限空间里，夹在 Kumon-mi 和 Yasu 的死亡次元之类的地方中间。

lines.en: Suffice it to say, I regret having gotten out of bed and I regret deciding that I want coffee. Specific coffee from a specific shop a decent ways away from my house at that.
lines.zh: 话不多说，我后悔起床了，也后悔决定要喝咖啡。而且是离我家有相当一段距离的某家特定店里的特定咖啡。

lines.en: So here I am at Koi Cafe — home of the [[copyrighted frozen beverage] and a staff of young girls that could set any future (or present) criminal’s heart ablaze.
lines.zh: 于是我来到了 Koi Cafe——[[受版权保护的冰饮]之家，还有一群能让任何未来（或现在）的罪犯心潮澎湃的年轻女孩。

lines.en: Except the “closed” sign is hung up and there’s not a single customer to be seen apart from me, who is only {i}sometimes{/i} a customer in the first place.
lines.zh: 只不过「休息中」的牌子挂着，除了我之外一个客人都看不到——而我本来也只能算{i}半个{/i}客人。

lines.en: scene black
Regardless, I spot Haruka and Rin inside and decide to enter, exercising my secret ability of basically never encountering locked doors.
lines.zh: 不管怎样，我看见 Haruka 和 Rin 在里面，于是决定进去，行使我「基本上从来遇不到锁着的门」这项隐秘能力。

lines.en: scene harukacaferegret1
: UUUUUUUUUUUUUUGHHHHHHHHH...
lines.zh: : 呜呜呜呜呜呜呜呜呃呃呃呃呃呃……

lines.en: : Hey, chill. I’m sure everything will be fine. You’ve just gotta...you know...clear things up with the BBB.
lines.zh: : 嘿，冷静点。我相信一切都会没事的。你只要……你知道的……跟商业改进局把事情解释清楚就行了。

lines.en: : I had no idea they even operated in Japan! And I hate having to deal with all of that bureaucratic stuff! Just let me make coffee in peace!
lines.zh: : 我根本不知道他们在日本也有业务！而且我最讨厌处理那种官僚主义的破事了！让我安安静静煮咖啡不行吗！

lines.en: : Is something wrong?
lines.zh: : 出什么事了？

lines.en: scene harukacaferegret2
: When the hell did you get here?
lines.zh: : 你他妈什么时候来的？

lines.en: : Everything is wrong! And it’s all your fault!
lines.zh: : 全完了！而且都是你的错！

lines.en: : Just not really. And don’t get mad at me for blaming you this time because I’m only half serious. But UGHHHHHHHHHH! FUCK!
lines.zh: : 也不全是。这次别怪我甩锅，因为我只有一半是认真的。但是呜呃呃呃呃呃呃！操！

lines.en: : Rin, since Haruka appears to be in a state of disrepair, would you mind explaining to me what’s going on here?
lines.zh: : Rin，既然 Haruka 看起来已经处于崩溃状态，能不能麻烦你给我解释一下这儿到底怎么回事？

lines.en: : Somebody filed a fake complaint to the Better Business Bureau about a couple having sex in the cafe and-
lines.zh: : 有人向商业改进局投诉，说有一对男女在咖啡馆里做爱，然后——

lines.en: scene harukacaferegret3
: OH MY GOD IT WAS YOU TWO, WASN’T IT?!
lines.zh: : 我的天哪，那是你们俩对吧？！

lines.en: : Well, that didn’t take you very long to figure out.
lines.zh: : 嗯，你猜出来倒是没花多少时间。

lines.en: : Could it really not wait?! Is your lust that powerful?!
lines.zh: : 就这么等不及吗？！你的性欲到底有多强？！

lines.en: : Haruka’s lust is that powerful. I showed up to get a drink and she attacked me. The only thing I could do to defend myself was fuck her into submission.
lines.zh: : 是 Haruka 的性欲那么强。我是来买喝的，结果她扑上来了。我唯一能自卫的办法，就是把她肏到服软。

lines.en: scene harukacaferegret4
: Okay. {i}Now,{/i} I’m blaming you.
lines.zh: : 好。{i}现在，{/i}我要怪你了。

lines.en: : Sensei, this is serious! The cafe could get shut down because of this and I literally {i}just{/i} got a promotion!
lines.zh: : Sensei，这可是大事！咖啡馆可能会因为这事被关掉，而我才{i}刚{/i}升职！

lines.en: : Imagine how my resume will look if I have to put “Supervisor for one week at a cafe that got shut down due to sexy stuff.”
lines.zh: : 想想看，要是我得在简历上写「在一家因色情事件被关停的咖啡馆当了一周的主管」，那简历会成什么样子。

lines.en: : Everywhere I apply to after this will think {i}I{/i} leveraged my power to do the sexy stuff! Think of my future!
lines.zh: : 这之后我不管去哪儿应聘，人家都会以为{i}我{/i}是滥用职权去搞那些色情的事！为我的未来想想吧！

lines.en: : You know you could just...leave out that last part, right?
lines.zh: : 你知道你可以……把最后那部分省掉吧？

lines.en: : And lie on my resume?! What kind of adult are you?!
lines.zh: : 然后在简历上撒谎？！你算什么成年人？！

lines.en: : The kind that convinces innocent shop owners to strip naked and bend over the counter so he can fuck them doggystyle in front of customers!
lines.zh: : 就是那种会说服无辜的店主脱光衣服、趴在柜台上，好让他当着客人的面用后入式肏她的成年人！

lines.en: scene harukacaferegret5
: That’s literally insane! Please provide more specific details or I’ll have no choice but to not believe you!
lines.zh: : 这简直疯了！请提供更具体的细节，否则我只能选择不信！

lines.en: : My life is over. My career is over. We have customers who know I’m married. It's only a matter of time before word spreads all the way up into space and my husband finds out.
lines.zh: : 我的人生完了。我的事业完了。有客人知道我结婚了。消息迟早会一路传到太空，然后被我丈夫发现。

lines.en: scene harukacaferegret6
: Well, maybe you should have thought about that before having sex with another man at your workplace! Were you {i}asking{/i} to get caught?! Because that’s what it sounds like!
lines.zh: : 那你在工作场所和另一个男人上床之前，是不是该先想想这些？！你是{i}求{/i}着被人抓吗？！因为听起来就是这样！

lines.en: : We were closed for the night. Molly forgot to lock the doors. No one was ever supposed to find us.
lines.zh: : 我们那会儿已经打烊了。Molly 忘了锁门。本来就不该有人发现我们的。

lines.en: scene harukacaferegret7
: The walls are made of glass, you idiot! Of course people were going to find you!
lines.zh: : 墙是玻璃做的，你这白痴！当然会有人发现你们啊！

lines.en: scene black

I pull up a chair, knowing full well that this isn’t going to be a discussion I can just back away from. And no, it’s not {i}just{/i} because I played a role in the scenario that landed Haruka in hot water.
lines.zh: 我拉过一把椅子坐下，心里很清楚这不是一场我能抽身而退的讨论。而且不，这不{i}全{/i}是因为害 Haruka 惹上麻烦的那件事里也有我一份。

lines.en: It’s because I care about this place. And I know how much it means to her.
lines.zh: 是因为我在乎这个地方。也知道它对她有多重要。

lines.en: She's worked toward owning this cafe for her whole life, and I’m not about to sit idly by and watch as it’s taken from her because she is a cheating whore who is addicted to my penis.
lines.zh: 她这辈子都在为拥有这家咖啡馆而努力，我不会袖手旁观，看着它因为她是个沉迷于我鸡巴的出轨婊子而被夺走。

lines.en: scene harukacaferegret8
: {i}Hah...{/i}you must think I’m a failure...don’t you, Rin?
lines.zh: : {i}哈……{/i}你一定觉得我是个失败者吧……对吧，Rin？

lines.en: : Noooo...I don’t think you’re a failure, Haruka. I think it’s perfectly reasonable to have sex with my teacher on the counter where we serve customers. That’s a really...normal thing to do.
lines.zh: : 不不不……我不觉得你是失败者，Haruka。我觉得在我们端给客人的柜台上和老师做爱是完全合理的。那是件很……正常的事。

lines.en: : I’m never having sex again...
lines.zh: : 我再也不做爱了……

lines.en: : Hey now, let’s not get too hasty here.
lines.zh: : 哎，别这么草率。

lines.en: : Sure, what we did was kind of stupid in hindsight. But I’ve had a lot of dangerous sex over the last few years and it’s only rarely resulted in negative consequences. There was no way we could have known.
lines.zh: : 当然，我们做的事事后回想起来是挺蠢的。但过去几年我做过很多危险的性事，很少真的闹出负面后果。我们不可能事先知道。

lines.en: scene harukacaferegret9
: Again! Glass windows! You don’t even live that far from here! You could have had all the sex you wanted at home!
lines.zh: : 又来了！玻璃窗！你住得离这儿又不远！你们本来可以在家里想怎么肏就怎么肏！

lines.en: : But that’s where Ami lives.
lines.zh: : 可 Ami 住在那儿啊。

lines.en: : Then you could have done it in my room while I pretended to be asleep! There were a zillion options beside the Koi Cafe lobby!
lines.zh: : 那你们也可以在我房间里做啊，我装睡就行了！除了 Koi Cafe 大堂之外还有一万个选项！

lines.en: : But none of them seemed as exciting and Haruka needed to be immediately punished for failing a task I gave her.
lines.zh: : 可没有一个选项有那么刺激，而且 Haruka 没完成我交给她的任务，需要立刻受罚。

lines.en: : What does that even mean?!
lines.zh: : 那到底是什么意思？！

lines.en: scene harukacaferegret10
: I gave him complete control over my body and he used it against me.
lines.zh: : 我把自己身体的全部控制权交给了他，而他用它来对付我。

lines.en: : Wasn’t that sort of the whole point?
lines.zh: : 这不正是重点所在吗？

lines.en: : C...Complete control? What do you mean by “complete control?”
lines.zh: : 全……全部控制权？你说的「全部控制权」是什么意思？

lines.en: : It means that I have to do what Sensei says any time he wants me to do something sexual with zero limits whatsoever.
lines.zh: : 意思是只要他想做点性方面的事，我就必须照做，而且没有任何限制。

lines.en: : So...if he asked you to, like...do stuff right now...
lines.zh: : 那……如果他让你，比如说……现在就做点什么……

lines.en: : Yup.
scene harukacaferegret11
: I don’t believe that. I’m going to have to see it in action to know that you two aren’t just messing with me.
lines.zh: : 我不信。我得亲眼看到，才知道你们俩不是在耍我。

lines.en: : The power is in your hands, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 权力在你手上，Sensei。

lines.en: : As great as that sounds, I really feel like this is the actual {i}worst{/i} time to utilize that power. You know, since this is the {i}exact thing{/i} you just got in trouble for.
lines.zh: : 听着是很棒，但我真觉得现在是行使那份权力的{i}最糟{/i}时机。你知道的，毕竟这{i}正是{/i}你刚惹上麻烦的事。

lines.en: scene harukacaferegret12
: R...Right! We need to come up with some sort of gameplan about how we’re going to get out of this mess.
lines.zh: : 对……对！我们得想个对策，好从这团乱麻里脱身。

lines.en: : How am I supposed to make a gameplan? The only thing I’m good for is sex.
lines.zh: : 我怎么可能想得出对策？我唯一的用处就是做爱。

lines.en: : She {i}is{/i} very good for sex. She’s not wrong.
lines.zh: : 她做爱{i}确实{/i}很好用。这点她没说错。

lines.en: : See?
lines.zh: : 看吧？

lines.en: : That’s Sensei’s penis talking. You’re good for tons of stuff, Haruka. And when you’re not getting railed next to all the pastries, you’re a really great boss.
lines.zh: : 那是 Sensei 的鸡巴在说话。你有用得很，Haruka。只要你不挨着那堆点心被人肏，你就是个非常好的老板。

lines.en: scene harukacaferegret13
: You really mean that?...
lines.zh: : 你真的这么想？……

lines.en: : Of course. And I’m going to do everything {i}I{/i} can to get you out of this. Mark my words.
lines.zh: : 当然。而且我会尽{i}我{/i}所能帮你脱身。记住我的话。

lines.en: : I know my track record concerning decisions both made and proposed within this cafe has not been great lately, but maybe it’s a {i}bad{/i} idea to get the high school girl involved in an active sex scandal.
lines.zh: : 我知道我最近在这家咖啡馆里做出和提出的决定，战绩都不太好看，但让一个高中女生卷进一场正在进行的性丑闻，也许是件{i}坏{/i}事。

lines.en: : Sensei’s right, Rin. I appreciate the concern, but this is something I’m going to have to figure out on my own. Just do whatever you can to...not let the rest of the girls find out about this, okay?
lines.zh: : Sensei 说得对，Rin。你的关心我心领了，但这是我自己必须解决的事。你只要尽力……别让其他姑娘知道这件事，好吗？

lines.en: : It’s just one person’s complaint right now. And I’m not sure how this is supposed to be {i}investigated,{/i} but the fewer people who know what’s going on, the better.
lines.zh: : 现在还只是一个人的投诉。我也不清楚这事会怎么{i}调查{/i}，但知道内情的人越少越好。

lines.en: : What should I tell them then? Because I was supposed to send out the new schedule this morning.
lines.zh: : 那我该怎么跟她们说？因为我本来今天早上要把新排班表发出去的。

lines.en: : Just tell them we’re having...renovations done or something. I don’t know. If anything, they’ll probably all be excited to have off.
lines.zh: : 就告诉她们我们……在装修什么的。我也不知道。要是真有什么，她们大概都会为能放假而兴奋。

lines.en: : Got it. I’ll head over to the office and come up with something now.
lines.zh: : 明白。我现在就去办公室想办法。

lines.en: scene harukacaferegret14
: Sensei, can I leave you alone for a few minutes without you commanding Haruka to bend over again?
lines.zh: : Sensei，我能把你单独留几分钟，而你不会命令 Haruka 再趴下吗？

lines.en: : I don’t know. She was wrong to ever give me this power in the first place and I don’t understand why she doesn’t just take it away.
lines.zh: : 不好说。她当初把这份权力交给我就是错的，我也不明白她为什么不干脆收回去。

lines.en: : The only thing I regret is getting caught. We should have done it in Rin’s room like she said.
lines.zh: : 我唯一后悔的就是被抓。我们早该听 Rin 的话，在她房间里做。

lines.en: : If only we had known back then.
lines.zh: : 要是当时知道就好了。

lines.en: scene harukacaferegret15
: Is the offer still on the table?
lines.zh: : 那个提议还算数吗？

lines.en: : Forget the offer, Haruka! If you’re not going to let me get involved, the least you can do is snap out of horny mode and figure out a way to get our cafe back! Got it?!
lines.zh: : 别管什么提议了，Haruka！你要是不让我掺和，至少能不能从发情模式里清醒过来，想个办法把我们的咖啡馆救回来？！听懂了吗？！

lines.en: scene harukacaferegret16
: {i}Hah...{/i}Yeah...I’ve got it. I’m sorry you have to deal with this, Rin. If I had known earlier, I never would have had you come in.
lines.zh: : {i}哈……{/i}好……我听懂了。很抱歉让你摊上这事，Rin。我要是早知道，绝不会让你过来。

lines.en: : It’s fine. Just...let me know if you need anything.
lines.zh: : 没事。只是……需要什么就告诉我。

lines.en: scene black
: I’ll be in the office if you need me.
lines.zh: : 有事的话我在办公室。

lines.en: scene harukacaferegret17
: Man...I can’t believe that guy actually filed a complaint. How miserable does your sex life have to be for you to to cry about another couple boning in what was very obviously a closed business?
lines.zh: : 妈的……我真不敢相信那家伙居然真去投诉了。你的性生活得惨到什么程度，才会去哭诉另一对情侣在一家明摆着已经打烊的店里做爱？

lines.en: : His wife seemed pretty fine with it, too.
lines.zh: : 他老婆看起来倒挺乐在其中的。

lines.en: : His penis is probably small. He probably saw yours and got jealous.
lines.zh: : 他的鸡巴大概很小。他大概是看见了你的，然后嫉妒了。

lines.en: : I think it was a little too deep inside of you for anyone to see, Haruka.
lines.zh: : 我觉得它当时埋在你里面太深了，谁也看不见，Haruka。

lines.en: : Yeah, you’re probably right...
lines.zh: : 嗯，你大概是对的……

lines.en: scene harukacaferegret18
: God, that was so hot.
lines.zh: : 天哪，那可真够刺激的。

lines.en: : But now we must face the consequences.
lines.zh: : 但现在我们必须面对后果了。

lines.en: scene harukacaferegret19
: No, {i}I{/i} must face the consequences. {i}You’re{/i} fine. {i}You{/i} didn’t break any laws.
lines.zh: : 不，是{i}我{/i}必须面对后果。{i}你{/i}没事。{i}你{/i}又没犯法。

lines.en: : Well...did you? Because I’m not really sure how any of this works. Was what we did actually illegal?
lines.zh: : 嗯……你犯了吗？因为我实在不清楚这些是怎么算的。我们做的事真的违法吗？

lines.en: : I’m not sure. Public indecency maybe? Do I need to get a lawyer? What if they come onto me? You know how easily I crumble for people in positions of power.
lines.zh: : 我不确定。也许是公共猥亵？我需要请律师吗？万一他们找上门来怎么办？你知道我多容易在有权势的人面前垮掉。

lines.en: : I’m a teacher, Haruka. I’m not really in a position of power to anyone but my students.
lines.zh: : 我是个老师，Haruka。除了我的学生，我对谁都算不上什么有权势的人。

lines.en: : Whatever, man. I’m just lost and confused and also horny again but {i}now{/i} I can’t even do anything about that because I have to be an adult.
lines.zh: : 随便啦，老兄。我只是又迷茫又困惑，而且还又发骚了，可{i}现在{/i}我连这个都做不了，因为我得做个成年人。

lines.en: : Yeah...but you {i}are{/i} an adult. And I get that you’re really into this sex slave thing, but maybe it would be smart if we toned it down for a little and started rethinking just what we {i}should{/i} do and what {i}not{/i} to do.
lines.zh: : 是……可你{i}就是{/i}个成年人。而且我知道你很迷这个性奴的玩法，但也许我们该稍微收敛一点，重新想想什么{i}该{/i}做、什么{i}不{/i}该做。

lines.en: : If we start doing that, we’d have to end the whole thing since it’s built almost entirely on the concept of doing horrible things to people we shouldn’t be doing them with.
lines.zh: : 要是我们开始这么想，那整件事就得结束了——因为它几乎完全建立在「和不该做这些事的人做这些可怕的事」这个概念上。

lines.en: : Fair. But that’s not what we’re talking about right now.
lines.zh: : 有道理。但我们现在说的不是这个。

lines.en: : It’s not? I’m confused.
lines.zh: : 不是吗？我糊涂了。

lines.en: : Just...do your best to explain the situation. What comes next and what do we need to do?
lines.zh: : 就是……尽力把情况说清楚。接下来会怎样，我们需要做什么？

lines.en: scene harukacaferegret20
: It says here that they’re going to send someone in to “investigate the issue.” But whatever that means, I have no idea.
lines.zh: : 这上面说他们会派人来「调查此事」。但那到底是什么意思，我完全不知道。

lines.en: : They’re also requesting all surveillance footage from the cafe and any business that has cameras aimed toward it.
lines.zh: : 他们还要求提供咖啡馆的全部监控录像，以及任何摄像头朝向这里的商家的录像。

lines.en: : Do you have cameras in here?
lines.zh: : 你这儿有摄像头吗？

lines.en: : I do, but they were turned off when we were having sex. Which at first I was very upset about, but am now very thankful for. I have no idea what that means for the other businesses around here, though.
lines.zh: : 有，但我们做爱的时候它们关着。一开始我为此很不爽，现在却感激不尽。可我不知道这对周围其他商家意味着什么。

lines.en: scene harukacaferegret21
: I’m friendly with a few of them and think it {i}is{/i} possible that one of them might have caught something given how huge the cafe is...
lines.zh: : 我和其中几家关系不错，考虑到咖啡馆这么大，{i}说不定{/i}有一家拍到了什么……

lines.en: : But I don’t really know how I feel about walking into any of those places and asking them if they saw me getting fucked in my store and, if they did, to scrub the footage of it.
lines.zh: : 但我实在不知道，自己走进那些地方、问他们有没有看到我在自己店里被肏、如果有就把那段录像删掉，会是什么感觉。

lines.en: : Do you want me to do it?
lines.zh: : 要我去吗？

lines.en: : I don’t see how that’s any better.
lines.zh: : 我看不出那好在哪儿。

lines.en: : It would save you the shame, at least.
lines.zh: : 至少能替你省下那份羞耻。

lines.en: scene harukacaferegret22
: The shame is what I’m {i}least{/i} worried about at this point. I just don’t want anything happening to the store.
lines.zh: : 羞耻是我现在{i}最不{/i}担心的。我只是不希望店里出任何事。

lines.en: : I love this place. And without it, I wouldn’t {i}just{/i} be broke. I’d be lost. And the same goes for girls like Rin who rely on it for work experience and money.
lines.zh: : 我爱这个地方。没有它，我就不{i}只{/i}是破产，而是彻底迷失。对像 Rin 这样靠它赚工作经验和钱的姑娘来说也是一样。

lines.en: : Come to think of it, though. It’s probably {i}only{/i} Rin who would {i}really{/i} care. The rest of the girls probably couldn’t care less.
lines.zh: : 不过想想看，大概也{i}只有{/i} Rin {i}真的{/i}在乎。其他姑娘八成一点都不在意。

lines.en: : I’m sorry, Haruka. I shouldn’t have given you any commands while we were in here.
lines.zh: : 对不起，Haruka。我不该在这儿的时候给你下任何命令。

lines.en: scene harukacaferegret23
: And I shouldn’t have gone along with them. Even if that was arguably the hottest night of my life.
lines.zh: : 而我也不该照做。哪怕那大概是我这辈子最刺激的一晚。

lines.en: : It {i}was{/i} pretty great, wasn’t it?
lines.zh: : {i}确实{/i}挺棒的，不是吗？

lines.en: scene harukacaferegret24

: Getting fucked in front of strangers? Admitting it’s with someone other than my husband? Knowing anyone {i}else{/i} could show up at any moment? Like, holy shit. So many fantasies checked off at once.
lines.zh: : 在陌生人面前被肏？承认对方不是我丈夫？知道随时可能有{i}别人{/i}出现？就像，操啊。那么多幻想一次性全勾掉了。

lines.en: : Want to do it again right now?
lines.zh: : 想现在再来一次吗？

lines.en: : Yes please.
lines.zh: : 好的，请。

lines.en: : Have you learned absolutely nothing, Haruka?
lines.zh: : 你到底有没有吸取一点教训，Haruka？

lines.en: scene harukacaferegret25
: Aaaaaaah no! I can barely remember what life was like before I was a sex-crazed harlot! This seriously sucks, Sensei! I have no idea what to do!
lines.zh: : 啊——不要！我都快记不得在变成这个性欲失控的荡妇之前的生活是什么样的了！这真的糟透了，Sensei！我完全不知道该怎么办！

lines.en: : I’m sure you’ll be fine, Haruka.
lines.zh: : 我相信你会没事的，Haruka。

lines.en: scene harukacaferegret19
: But how can you be {i}sure?{/i} This is uncharted territory for both of us.
lines.zh: : 可你怎么能这么{i}肯定{/i}？这对我们俩都是未知领域。

lines.en: : It just sounds to me like, so long as no one {i}else{/i} has any footage of that night, it’s your word against his. It’s not like they can shut you down over one guy’s complaint if {i}he{/i} doesn’t have any evidence of it.
lines.zh: : 我听下来觉得，只要{i}别人{/i}手上没有那晚的录像，那就是你的一面之词对他的。{i}他{/i}拿不出证据，他们总不至于因为一个人的投诉就关你的店。

lines.en: : The worst that can happen is that word just...gets around or something. But even then, you could just say it’s a shitty rumor. Maybe even sue the guy for defamation or something if it affects your business.
lines.zh: : 最坏的情况无非是消息……传开了之类的。但就算那样，你也可以说那是个恶心的谣言。要是影响了生意，说不定还能告他诽谤什么的。

lines.en: scene harukacaferegret26
: He’d deserve it too. Limp-dicked loser.
lines.zh: : 他也活该。软屌的废物。

lines.en: : And hey, on the bright side, if word {i}does{/i} get around and you wind up attracting a bunch of attention from people who want to come here and see the barista who {i}allegedly{/i} gets fucked inside of her own store...
lines.zh: : 嘿，往好处想，如果消息{i}真{/i}传开了，反而吸引一堆人跑来看那个{i}据传{/i}在自己店里被人肏的咖啡师……

lines.en: scene harukacaferegret27
: I’d feel so embarrassed and objectified...and ashamed...
lines.zh: : 我会觉得又羞耻又被物化……又丢人……

lines.en: scene harukacaferegret28
: I’d never stop being wet again.
lines.zh: : 我大概会一直湿下去，再也停不下来。

lines.en: : {i}Now{/i} you’re thinking like the Haruka I know.
lines.zh: : {i}这才{/i}是我认识的那个 Haruka。

lines.en: : Is it bad that I’m kind of {i}hoping{/i} for that outcome now?
lines.zh: : 我现在居然有点{i}希望{/i}变成那样，是不是很糟糕？

lines.en: : Yes.
scene black
: But that’s exactly why I like you.
lines.zh: : 但这正是我喜欢你的原因。

lines.en: Haruka and I spend the next few minutes going over the notice she received before she decides that she {i}will{/i} check around with the other businesses to see if they caught anything on tape.
lines.zh: 接下来的几分钟里，我和 Haruka 一起又看了一遍她收到的通知，然后她决定{i}去{/i}周围商家问问有没有拍到什么。

lines.en: What that unfortunately means, though, is that the cafe is going to be closed for a little while.
lines.zh: 不幸的是，这意味着咖啡馆要暂停营业一阵子。

lines.en: Haruka claims she can probably get away with keeping it open while the investigation is active, but she thinks it’d be better for everyone if, at least for now, the doors remain shut under the guise of renovations.
lines.zh: Haruka 说调查期间她大概也能照常开门，但她觉得对所有人来说，至少现在先以装修为名把门关上更好。

lines.en: She says she’ll keep me updated on the progress of everything, but...considering it’s still early and I have nothing left to do now, I have to come up with some other way to kill time while everyone else is asleep.
lines.zh: 她说会随时向我同步进展，不过……考虑到现在还早，而我又没事可做，我得想点别的办法打发时间，趁其他人还在睡觉。

lines.en: That being said, I call out to Rin from the lobby as Haruka prepares for her walk of shame and decide to spend the rest of the morning killing time with my {i}other{/i} favorite barista.
lines.zh: 话虽如此，我在大堂朝 Rin 喊了一声，而 Haruka 则准备开始她的羞耻之旅，于是我决定用这个早晨剩下的时间，陪我{i}另一位{/i}最喜欢的咖啡师消磨时间。
